URL: https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy/the-interest-rate-bank-rate
(Approved-source context: Bank of England + Reuters poll + ONS, via search snippets, 27 July 2026)

- The Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee is expected to hold Bank Rate at 3.75% at its decision on Thursday 30 July.
- A Reuters poll found most economists expect rates to remain at 3.75% through 2026, though nearly 40% predict at least one hike; several forecast a 7-2 MPC split in favour of a hold.
- 30 July is a "Super Thursday": the decision comes with a full Monetary Policy Report (revised forecasts) and a Governor's press conference at 1:00pm.
- Context: CPI slowed to 2.6% in June (ONS), a 15-month low, driven by lower food and fuel inflation; the earlier oil rebound had prompted some traders to bring forward rate-rise expectations.
